name: Non-Square Product Obfuscation
description: Replaces the explicit routing steps or inequality conditions with a mathematical equivalent over the domain {1,2,3}: the product of the two assigned values must not be a perfect square. This completely hides the graph coloring structure behind a non-linear arithmetic constraint, forcing models to either recognize the finite-domain equivalence or attempt to solve it as a general constraint satisfaction problem without optimized coloring heuristics.
